svg.text: Java 21 Spring Boot on Amazon EKS · infrastructure as code with Terraform · CI/CD with Jenkins and Helm · region ap-south-1 (Mumbai)
Docker · Trivy · Helm · kubectl · AWS CLI
IAM role: push to ECR, deploy to EKS
SSH from admin CIDR + Session Manager
turns the Ingress into the ALB
No password is stored in Git,
in the image or in Helm values.
Both pods run the same schedule;
one pod run each reminder job.
IRSA roles: hr-portal-app, ESO, LB Controller
notification emails from a verified sender
API: private endpoint for Jenkins and bastion,
public endpoint limited to the admin CIDR
IRSA: a pod gets AWS rights
account. No AWS keys exist in
the app, the image or Git.
Payslip and document downloads go straight from S3 to the browser: presigned link, valid 5 minutes, HTTPS
Database subnets · 10.0.20.0/24, 10.0.21.0/24 · no route to the internet
Amazon EKS 1.35 · managed node group: 2 × t3.medium
